name: PdxSlider
description:
A slider the user drags or moves from the keyboard to pick a value, or a range with two thumbs,
with marks and value labels.

members.name: min
members.description: Minimum allowed value.

members.name: max
members.description: Maximum allowed value.

members.name: step
members.description: Increment step.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

members.name: label
members.description:
What the slider sets ("Volume"): the thumb's name, and in range mode "{label}, minimum" /
"{label}, maximum". Not needed after a pdx-label, which names it.

members.name: marks
members.description: Comma-separated mark values, or "step" to show all steps

members.name: showLabel
members.description: Show value label on thumb while dragging

members.name: labelAlways
members.description: Always show label (not just on drag)

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name, submitted with the form.

members.name: error
members.description: Marks the control as invalid.

members.name: range
members.description: Two thumbs: `value` is `[low, high]`; the `value` attribute may give it as `"low,high"`.

members.name: minGap
members.description: Minimum gap between thumbs in range mode

members.name: size
members.description: sm, md (the default) or lg: the track's and thumb's size.

members.name: color
members.description: primary (the default), success or warning: the fill's and thumb's colour.

members.name: orientation
members.description: horizontal (the default) or vertical.

members.name: value
members.description: The value, or `[low, high]` with `range`. A form submits it; a range as two entries, the low then the high (#135).

members.name: focus
members.description: Moves focus to it.

members.name: blur
members.description: Removes focus from it.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the value.

events.name: pdx-change-end
events.description: A drag ended: the value it left, `[low, high]` in range mode.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.

cssParts.name: root
cssParts.description: The frame the pointer acts on.

cssParts.name: fill
cssParts.description: The coloured portion: from the minimum to the value, or between the thumbs.

cssParts.name: thumb
cssParts.description: A thumb, `role="slider"`: one, or two in range mode; aria-invalid with `error`.

cssStates.name: invalid

cssStates.name: dragging
